harness_source:
extends SceneTree
var main: ReefMain
var out: String
func _init() -> void:
	call_deferred("run")
func frames(count: int) -> void:
	for index: int in range(count):
		await process_frame
func shot(name: String) -> void:
	await RenderingServer.frame_post_draw
	var pixels: Image = root.get_texture().get_image()
	pixels.save_png(out.path_join(name + ".png"))
	print("ALPHA_REVIEW|", name, "|", pixels.get_size())
func contact(action: DayOneContactAction2D, name: String) -> void:
	var deadline: int = Time.get_ticks_msec() + 10000
	while Time.get_ticks_msec() < deadline and action.work_time < 0.1:
		await process_frame
	if not action.in_contact():
		print("ALPHA_REVIEW|CONTACT_TIMEOUT|", name)
		quit(1)
		return
	action.set_process(false)
	if name == "waterfall_hand_contact":
		var owner: PoolWaterfallActivity = action.get_parent() as PoolWaterfallActivity
		print("ALPHA_REVIEW|SCRUBBER|", owner._scrubber.visible, " parent=", owner.visible, " at=", owner._scrubber.global_position, " hand=", action.to_global(action.hand_offset), " z=", owner._scrubber.z_index)
	await shot(name)
	action.set_process(true)
	await create_timer(0.8).timeout
func run() -> void:
	Engine.max_fps = 60
	root.mode = Window.MODE_WINDOWED
	root.size = Vector2i(1280, 720)
	root.content_scale_size = Vector2i(1280, 720)
	out = OS.get_environment("ALPHA_REVIEW_OUT")
	DirAccess.make_dir_recursive_absolute(out)
	main = load("res://scenes/main.tscn").instantiate() as ReefMain
	root.add_child(main)
	await frames(3)
	if main.start_menu_active:
		main._start_menu_ref()._dismiss_menu()
	main._skip_intro()
	main.save_data["quality"] = "speedy"
	main._day_one_ref().restore_state({"day_one_active":true,
		"day_one_completed_rooms":["bathroom","pool","stuffie"]})
	main.level2_done_once = true
	main._enter_level2_now(true, false, false)
	await frames(12)
	main._enter_castle_interior_now(false)
	await frames(18)
	main._castle_rooms_ref().show_room("craft_room", false)
	await frames(12)
	main._open_day_one_art_studio()
	main._day_one_cancel_story_clips()
	await frames(8)
	var art: DayOneArtStudio = main._day_one_art_studio
	await shot("art_before")
	art._on_material_pressed("brushes")
	await create_timer(0.15).timeout
	await shot("art_approach")
	await contact(art._contact_action, "art_material_contact")
	for material: String in DayOneDirector.ART_MATERIAL_IDS:
		main.day_one_record_art_cleanup("material", material)
	art.refresh_from_state()
	art._on_grime_pressed("desk_counter")
	await contact(art._contact_action, "art_grime_contact")
	main._close_day_one_art_studio()
	main._day_one_ref().restore_state({"day_one_active":true,
		"day_one_completed_rooms":["bathroom"],"day_one_pool_cleanup_step":1,"day_one_current_room":"pool","day_one_pool_skimmer_mask":63,
		"day_one_pool_waterfall_mask":0,"day_one_pool_seahorse_tugs":0})
	main._castle_rooms_ref().show_room("mermaid_pool", false)
	main._day_one_cancel_story_clips()
	await frames(8)
	var pool: DayOnePoolCleanup = main._castle_rooms_ref().day_one_pool_cleanup
	var waterfall: PoolWaterfallActivity = pool.waterfall_activity
	print("ALPHA_REVIEW|POOL_STATE|", pool.audit_snapshot())
	waterfall._begin_touch(waterfall.fixture_center, 0)
	print("ALPHA_REVIEW|WATERFALL_ACTION|", waterfall._contact_action.active, " available=", waterfall._contact_action.available(), " paused=", paused)
	await contact(waterfall._contact_action, "waterfall_hand_contact")
	waterfall.cancel_touch()
	main.day_one_record_pool_activity_progress(63, 7, 0)
	main.day_one_record_pool_cleanup_step(2)
	main._castle_rooms_ref().show_room("mermaid_pool", false)
	main._day_one_cancel_story_clips()
	await frames(8)
	pool = main._castle_rooms_ref().day_one_pool_cleanup
	var seahorse: PoolSeahorseRescueActivity = pool.seahorse_activity
	seahorse._register_tap(seahorse.fixture_center)
	await contact(seahorse._contact_action, "seahorse_hand_contact")
	print("ALPHA_REVIEW|RENDERER|", RenderingServer.get_current_rendering_method())
	quit()
